en-US.description: An intelligent Alexa skill that leverages OpenAI's powerful language models to answer questions, explain concepts, and provide detailed information on a wide variety of topics. Simply ask your question and get comprehensive, AI-powered responses through your Alexa device.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: This skill requires OpenAI API key configuration. Test by asking questions like 'what is machine learning' or 'explain photosynthesis'.
